new_content.name: Preserving enchantment
new_content.notes: Leaves mined keep their colour in any biome; craft a preserved leaf alone to revert.

new_content.name: New armor trim materials
new_content.how_to_obtain: Use blaze powder, echo shard, enchanted golden apple, ender pearl, honeycomb, nether star, prismarine shard, slimeball or turtle scute at a smithing table.

mechanics.title: Material set bonuses
mechanics.description: A full set trimmed with one material grants a bonus (e.g. gold: piglins neutral; iron: iron golems ignore you; ender pearl: endermen ignore gaze; resin: creakings ignore you; diamond: +1 effective Efficiency; netherite set: fire resistance).

mechanics.title: Pattern set bonuses
mechanics.description: A full set with one trim pattern grants a bonus (e.g. Eye: extra damage to endermen; Wild: poison immunity). Bolt and Flow have active abilities on the Use Trim Ability key.

mechanics.title: Wandering trader templates
mechanics.description: 20% chance a wandering trader sells a random smithing template, priced like duplicating it.

vanilla_changes.change: A full set of armor trimmed with the gold material makes piglins neutral, like gold armor; normal gold armor still works.

commands_and_keybinds: Use Trim Ability: set in Options > Controls (Bolt and Flow patterns).
getting_started: Trim all four armor pieces with the same material or pattern at a smithing table.
editor_notes: Facts come from the mod's README (1.3.0-beta.0), not from the jar or in-game testing. Replaces Distracting Trims; the Gold material bonus covers piglin neutrality. See MOB-4, MOB-14 and MOB-15 in the guide test plan.
name: Effective Gear
summary: New armor trim materials, a Preserving enchantment for shears, and set bonuses for wearing a full set of armor with the same trim material or pattern.
